text: Wanted a simple app to guide me through my morning routine &stay on task, this app does it Switching from another similar app the things I like are: -straightforward privacy policy -storage efficient, doesn't crash when I leave the app -reasonably priced premium with a lifetime option things I miss: -skip button to finish a routine even if I can't do some steps on a given day -previous step button, to go back if I accidentally move on to the next -ability to see full steps when running routine
